description: Listed building consent for erection of a single storey rear infill extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Design/Access & Heritage Report and Flood Risk Assessment, Received: 6 August 2020;  CSE_01A; CSE_12D; CSE_13 B  Received: 21 December 2020 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in type, colour, texture and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution, including brick facebond and pointing, other than where specified on the approved drawings.  The roof lights hereby approved in the new sloping roof shall be 'conservation type' and permanently retained as such, the roof lights in the flat roof section shall not exceed the height of the adjacent parapet and shall be formed of flat planed horizontally laid glass.

Condition : 4 - The rear doors and windows shall not be installed until detailed drawings, including sections at a scale of not less than 1:20 and specifications of them have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The doors and windows shall be installed as approved and permanently retained thereafter.
